title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libreswan security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in libreswan, an implementation of IPsec and IKE for Linux used to build secure VPN tunnels. The issues include an IKEv2 Use-After-Free bug when using IKE-over-TCP, a pre-authentication null pointer dereference in the EAP code, and a null pointer dereference in the PKCS#7 bundle with no certificates. These vulnerabilities have been rated as important by Red Hat and affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. An update is available to address these issues.
